nodes.label: KP-STAFF-2026 workbook
nodes.rationale: Excel workbook (KP-STAFF-2026.xlsx) holding one weekly checklist sheet per staff member for 2026, plus a blank template and a store-asset sheet.

nodes.label: CHECKLIST STAFF sheet (blank template)
nodes.rationale: Unfilled master copy of the staff checklist: 12 monthly blocks (Jan-Dec 2026), every total 0 and every % #DIV/0!.

nodes.label: CHECKLIST KEDAI sheet (store asset condition)
nodes.rationale: Weekly store-asset condition check per month: each asset gets TICK (/), CATATAN and TARIKH PENYELESAIAN per week; filled Jan-Sep 2026, Oct-Dec empty.

nodes.label: Checklist Mingguan (SA/CA/PT/TJH) form
nodes.rationale: Weekly staff checklist form; title names the staff grades it applies to (SA/CA/PT/TJH). Seven numbered kategori with lettered perkara, each scored per week.

nodes.label: KP0093 SYAZANA IZZAH ZAFIRAH (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: Marked Jan-Mar by khairul, Apr-Aug by AZIZUL; monthly SV/AS avg 0.81 Jan, 0.8 Apr-Aug; Feb/Mar #DIV/0! (incomplete weeks); Sep headers prefilled, no marks.

nodes.label: KP0103 PUTRI WAHIDA AMALIN (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: Same pattern as KP0093: khairul Jan-Mar, AZIZUL Apr-Sep; 0.811 Jan, 0.8 Apr-Aug.

nodes.label: KP0108 NOR ASYIKIN (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: No marks Jan-May (likely joined mid-year); AZIZUL marks from June; 0.8 Jun-Aug.

nodes.label: KP0110 FILZAH DIYANA (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: Entirely unfilled for 2026; every monthly average #DIV/0!.

nodes.label: KP0111 PUTERI NUR HAFIZA (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: Entirely unfilled for 2026; every monthly average #DIV/0!.

nodes.label: MY0544 U TIN TUN (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: khairul Jan-Mar, AZIZUL Apr-Sep; 0.81 Jan, 0.8 Apr-Aug.

nodes.label: MY0606 AH SAN (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: khairul Jan-Mar, AZIZUL Apr-Sep; 0.81 Jan, 0.8 Apr-Aug.

nodes.label: MY0644 PYHI SI THU (staff sheet)
nodes.rationale: No marks Jan-Mar; AZIZUL from April; 0.8 Apr-Aug.

nodes.label: khairul (khairul bin talib) - SV/AS marker Jan-Mar 2026
nodes.rationale: Fills the SV/AS column and the store-asset sheet from January to March 2026.

nodes.label: AZIZUL - SV/AS marker Apr-Sep 2026
nodes.rationale: Takes over SV/AS marking and the store-asset sheet from April 2026 onward.

nodes.label: Sheet naming by payroll ID (KP/MY prefix + name)
nodes.rationale: Each staff sheet is named <payroll ID>_<NAME>; KP-prefixed and MY-prefixed IDs coexist (MY likely a separate payroll series, e.g. foreign workers).

Score scale list (N/A, 1-5)
nodes.rationale: Column A of the template lists N/A,1,2,3,4,5 - the allowed per-perkara scores (dropdown source). Observed marks are almost all 4 or 5.

nodes.label: WEEK 1-4 columns per month
nodes.rationale: Each monthly block has exactly four week columns; there is no WEEK 5, so a five-Saturday month cannot be fully recorded. Week 4 of January is dated 2026-02-07.

nodes.label: TARIKH (week date) row
nodes.rationale: Per-week date, typically a Saturday (e.g. 2026-01-24, 2026-01-31), sometimes mid-month first entry (2026-01-15).

nodes.label: NAMA (marker name) row
nodes.rationale: Records who filled the SV/AS column that week.

nodes.label: SV/AS verification column
nodes.rationale: First-tier mark by supervisor / assistant supervisor; the only tier ever filled in this workbook.

nodes.label: MANAGER verification column
nodes.rationale: Second-tier mark by the manager; never filled on any sheet, so every MGR total is 0 and every MGR % is #DIV/0!.

nodes.label: CATATAN (remarks) rows
nodes.rationale: Free-text remark row after each kategori; never filled on any staff sheet.

nodes.label: CADANGAN (suggestions) column
nodes.rationale: Suggestion column beside the week columns; never filled.

nodes.label: JUMLAH MARKAH (total marks and maximum)
nodes.rationale: Per tier per week: sum of scores and a maximum = 5 x number of perkara actually scored (blank perkara excluded, e.g. 77/95 with 19 scored, 81/100 with 20).

nodes.label: Weekly % = total / maximum
nodes.rationale: Weekly percentage; returns #DIV/0! when the week has no scores (maximum 0).

nodes.label: Monthly summary table (MONTH | SV/AS | MGR)
nodes.rationale: Top-right table on each sheet with one row per month (2026-01-01..2026-12-01) pulling the month's SV/AS and MGR average of weekly %.

nodes.label: <BACK navigation link
nodes.rationale: Hyperlink cell on each month block and staff sheet header back to an index/summary.

nodes.label: #DIV/0! error pattern
nodes.rationale: The monthly average is a plain average over all four weeks, so any unfilled week (Feb/Mar with 3 or 1 week, September with headers but no marks, all MGR cells) turns the whole month into #DIV/0!.

nodes.label: Unfilled / partially filled weeks
nodes.rationale: Feb filled 3 of 4 weeks, Mar only week 1; September has dates and NAMA prefilled but no marks; KP0110 and KP0111 never marked.

nodes.label: Uniform 0.8 marking Apr-Aug
nodes.rationale: From April every perkara for every marked staff is scored 4, giving exactly 0.8 every week - marks show no differentiation between staff.

nodes.label: TICK (/) / CATATAN / TARIKH PENYELESAIAN columns
nodes.rationale: Per week, each store asset gets a tick that it was checked, a remark, and a resolution date.

nodes.label: DIISIKAN OLEH (filled by)
nodes.rationale: khairul bin talib Jan-Mar, AZIZUL Apr-Sep.

nodes.label: DIPERIKSA OLEH (checked by)
nodes.rationale: Verifier row for the store-asset sheet; never filled.

nodes.label: Store asset F) SALURAN AIR TANDAS
Recurring air-cond faults (Jan, Apr-Jul 2026)
nodes.rationale: Units not cooling / compressor failures logged repeatedly; one set replaced 2026-05-05, compressor replaced in July; escalated as 'sdh report dlm group'.

nodes.label: Damaged floor tiles (May-Aug 2026)
nodes.rationale: Logged under LAIN-LAIN every week from late May, marked as reported in the group chat but no resolution date.

nodes.label: Mixed date formats in TARIKH (datetime vs dd/mm/yy text)
nodes.rationale: Dates are a mix of real dates and dd/mm/yy text; January week 4 shows 2026-07-02, likely 07/02/26 parsed month-first (should be 7 Feb, matching staff sheets' 2026-02-07).
